name: Nundasuchus
isnote: Analyses cited by the English Wikipedia (Nesbitt et al. 2014; Ezcurra 2016) place it variously as a suchian related to Paracrocodylomorpha or near the base of Pseudosuchia, so it is placed in Pseudosuchia.
sum: Nundasuchus is a crurotarsan archosaur from the Middle Triassic Manda beds of Tanzania, with an upright limb posture.
wsnote: No body-length estimate is given in the sources consulted.
holotype: A single partially complete skeleton (vertebrae, limb elements, osteoderms and skull fragments) from the Manda beds; catalogue number not given in the sources consulted.
biology: Its legs were held directly beneath the body, as in many early pseudosuchians but unlike living crocodilians.
author: Nesbitt et al. 2014
